question: Mohiniyattam is a solo classical dance form related to which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mohiniyattam** is a solo classical dance form of **Kerala **state.
 
• Mohiniyattam is **one of India's famous classical dances,** developed and still popular in the state of Kerala.
 
• This dance form derives its **name from Mohini**, the historical enchanting embodiment of the** Hindu god Vishnu**, who helps good to prevail over evil by nurturing its feminine energies. 
 
• It is a classical Indian dance that by implication, traces its repertoire to the basic text of **Natya Shastra.**
 
• The text of the **Natya Shastra **is credited to the ancient scholar **Bharata Muni.​**
